title: Closed-Form of the Local Galactic Potential and Stellar Distribution Function from Gaia DR3
abstract: arXiv:2609.09011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The local dark matter density determines the strength of the signal expected in direct-detection experiments, yet published estimates from stellar motions disagree by more than their errors, and the most recent machine-learning analysis of Gaia data finds a local density consistent with zero. According to Jeans' theorem, a distribution function built from integrals of motion satisfies the collisionless Boltzmann equation (CBE) trivially for any choice of potential, so a search that simultaneously fits the distribution function and the potential to the CBE identifies neither. Our pipeline instead estimates the distribution function in isolation, linearizing the equation in terms of accelerations and allowing for direct measurement of the local force field, and then fits closed forms to that field via symbolic regression. translated_title: 基于Gaia DR3数据的局域银河系势能与恒星分布函数的封闭形式解
translated_abstract: 局域暗物质密度决定了直接探测实验中预期信号的强度，然而基于恒星运动的已发表估计结果之间的分歧超过了其误差范围，且最近一项对Gaia数据的机器学习分析发现局域密度与零一致。根据金斯定理，由运动积分构建的分布函数对于任何势能选择都平凡地满足无碰撞玻尔兹曼方程（CBE），因此同时将分布函数和势能拟合到CBE的搜索方法无法确定两者中的任何一个。我们的流程改为单独估计分布函数，将该方程以加速度为变量进行线性化，从而允许对局域力场进行直接测量，然后通过符号回归为该力场拟合封闭形式解。在整个过程中，我们发现可用的信息不在于CBE残差，而在于恒星数量计数……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新方法，通过单独估计恒星分布函数、以加速度形式线性化无碰撞玻尔兹曼方程来直接测量局域力场，并利用符号回归获得局域银河系势能的封闭形式解，从而解决了同时拟合分布函数与势能时的退化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel pipeline that estimates the stellar distribution function in isolation, linearizes the collisionless Boltzmann equation in terms of accelerations to directly measure the local force field, and applies symbolic regression to obtain a closed-form solution for the local Galactic potential, avoiding the degeneracy that arises when fitting the distribution function and potential simultaneously.
